name: The Thread and the Sword
source:
Theseus, King of Athens, has been officially declared dead. His death raises one major question: who will be his successor on Athens' throne, between the oldest son of his widow Phaedra and the son he had from a previous union with the Queen of the Amazons, Hippolytus? 

Phaedra, to discuss this matter, and to ensure her sons don't pay the consequences of the years she spent bullying Hippolytus, demands to see her step-son. But seeing him makes her face the truth she has been avoiding: Phaedra is madly in love with Hippolytus, and she can't keep these feelings inside. 

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-thread-and-the-sword]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雅典国王忒修斯已被正式宣布死亡。他的死引发了一个重大问题：他的遗孀斐德拉的长子和他之前与亚马逊女王希波吕托斯的儿子之间，谁将成为他雅典王位的继承人？

为了讨论此事，并确保她的儿子们不会为她多年来欺负希波吕托斯的后果付出代价，菲德拉要求见她的继子。但看到他让她面对了她一直回避的事实：菲德拉疯狂地爱着希波吕托斯，而她无法将这些感情藏在心里。

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-thread-and-the-sword]itch.io[/url]]
